notes.title: Free Update and Discount Later Today!
notes.content:
Today marks our first update for Karate Krab. Red Sea is a new world away from the main story, where everything is more dangerous and a lot more red! 

These are 6 levels based off original ones from the main story but with a twist. 

Please enjoy this free update, we look forward to hearing your feedback.

Look out today for our first Steam Sale!
